name: Sheraton Nha Trang Hotel & Spa
short_description: A beachfront Sheraton high-rise on Tran Phu Boulevard in central Nha Trang, known for its 28th-floor Altitude rooftop bar and sixth-floor infinity pool with sweeping bay views.
ai_summary: The Sheraton Nha Trang Hotel & Spa is a 280-room high-rise set directly on Tran Phu Boulevard, opposite Nha Trang's main beach strip and within walking distance of the city's shopping and nightlife. Independent reviewers consistently single out the location and the views: most rooms and suites face the bay through floor-to-ceiling glass, and the sixth-floor infinity pool and 28th-floor Altitude rooftop bar draw particular praise for panoramic sunset outlooks. The buffet breakfast is repeatedly described as among the best guests have had, and the Shine Spa for Sheraton earns strong marks for its massages and hot-tub relaxation area. Marriott Bonvoy elites and Club-level guests highlight the top-floor Club Lounge, with sea views and generous evening food-and-drink service, though its access carries a nightly charge for non-qualifying guests. Watch-outs are consistent too: the building and rooms show some age and wear, balconies are small and unfurnished, corridors and lifts can feel warm without air-conditioning, and in-room or public-area internet has drawn complaints about cost. Service is generally warm and professional, with occasional hitches at busy times. Overall it reads as a reliable, well-located city-beach hotel that trades a little polish for strong views, dining and value.

faqs.question: How far is the Sheraton Nha Trang from Cam Ranh International Airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits on Tran Phu Boulevard in central Nha Trang, about 36 kilometres from Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR). By car the transfer usually takes around 45 minutes depending on traffic, so allow extra time when planning early departures or late arrivals from the airport.

faqs.question: Does the Sheraton Nha Trang have a rooftop bar and pool?
faqs.answer: Yes. Altitude Rooftop Bar occupies the 28th floor with panoramic city and beach views and is popular at sunset. There is also a sixth-floor outdoor infinity pool overlooking the bay, plus the Shine Spa for Sheraton with massage rooms and a relaxation hot tub.

faqs.question: Is the Sheraton Nha Trang a good choice for Marriott Bonvoy elites?
faqs.answer: It is well regarded by elites, who praise the top-floor Club Lounge for its sea views and evening food and drinks. Platinum-level and above members typically receive complimentary lounge access; other guests pay a nightly charge or must book a Club-level room to use it.
